main.description: APQC PCF (Process Classification Framework) Level-1 category record. AT Protocol record carrying one of the 13 canonical L1 process categories (v7.4) — `code` is the L1 identifier (e.g. '1.0', '13.0') and is used as the rkey verbatim for idempotent re-seeding. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: replaces the legacy `vertex_open_apqc_l1` RW table with an MST + IPFS-anchored record set so the substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) can anchor + replicate the L1 taxonomy without trusting this operator. Level-2 through Level-5 categories follow in later PRs as separate record lexicons (e.g. `com.etzhayyim.apqc.processGroup` for L2) reusing the same scaffold. Sibling lexicons under `com.etzhayyim.apqc.*` (`getProcess`, `materializeSubprocesses`, `coverageSnapshot`, `emitEvent`) remain as active procedures — record-vs-procedure split.

code.description: APQC PCF L1 category identifier (e.g. '1.0', '7.0', '13.0'). Format: digits + '.0' suffix for L1 (sibling levels L2/L3/L4/L5 use '1.1', '1.1.1', etc.; future PRs add separate record lexicons for those levels). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

name.description: Canonical English name of the L1 category.

level.description: PCF hierarchy depth. Always 1 for this lexicon (sentinel — future lexicons set 2/3/4/5).

version.description: APQC PCF version (e.g. '7.4.0'). Locks the record to a published revision so changes in future PCF releases produce new records under different rkeys when the L1 numbering changes.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the category's scope.

themes.description: Optional list of cross-cutting themes the L1 category touches (e.g. 'governance', 'innovation', 'risk'). Absent in the v7.4 baseline seed; reserved for future industry-cross-reference annotations.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was published. Defaults to the v7.4 release date 2023-11-01 unless the seeder overrides.
